headline: Kazakhstan intends to use associated gas for cryptocurrency mining
summary: Electricity generated from associated gas at oil fields is intended for industrial cryptocurrency mining in Kazakhstan. The plan was reported by PRIME.
why: Associated gas is produced alongside crude oil and is often flared when not used, so converting it to power affects energy use and the economics of mining.
